book.name: Wer Mamit
book.title: Wer Mamit Moloyo Wende Moko Duto

content.text: Mano kaka tiendeni beyo kirwako pat pat,
yaye nyar joka ruoth!
Tiendeni pichni ka kite ma nengogi tek,
ka gima jopecho molony ema opayo.
Pendi ogomo ka wend agwata,
ma divai moru maber ok rumie.
Nungoni chalo pidh ngano mochok kaachiel,
ma ondanyo olworo koni gi koni.
Thundeni chalo gi nyithind mwanda ariyo,
gichalo gi nyithind mwanda ma rude.
Ngʼuti chalo gi kar ngʼicho
motingʼore gi malo molos gi lak liech.
Wengeni nyawni ka pi Yawo mar Heshbon
but rangach mar Bath Rabim.
Umi chalo gi kar ngʼicho motingʼore gi malo
mar Lebanon momanyore gi Damaski.
Wiyi miyi duongʼ mana ka Got Karmel,
yie wiyi to ochanore ka orengo mar ruoth,
kendo omako pach ruoth.
Mano kaka ijaber kendo imiya mor,
mano kaka imora, yaye jaherana!
Dendi odongo mana ka othith,
to thundi to chalo mana ka olemo,
mogudore kanyachiel.
Ne awacho niya,
“Abiro lwenyo yiend othith;
nyaka amak olembe gi lweta.”
Mad thundeni chal gi olemb,
mzabibu mochokore kanyachiel,
to tik mar muchi chal gi olemo mayom,
kendo dhogi chal mana gi divai mamit.
Mad divai lor mos e dwond jaherana,
kamol mos e kind lewe kod lekene komadhe.
An mar jaherana,
kendo gombone ni kuoma.
Bi, jaherana, bi wadhi waba ei gwengʼ,
kendo wanind oko e bunge.
Bi wamondi gokinyi wadhi,
e puothe mzabibu mondo wangʼiane,
ka mzabibu oseolo,
bende wangʼiane ka gisechako thiewo,
kendo ka olembe mongʼinore oselokore makwar;
kuno, ema abiro miyie herana.
Kuno ema inyalo winjoe tik mar mandrake,
kendo e odwa kanyo okanni gik mamit,
motingʼo gik machon gi manyien,
ma asebedo ka akanoni, yaye jaherana.
